title: Add product to cart from home page featured products
description: Verify adding a featured product to cart works correctly
steps: Wait for featured products section to load
Click 'Agregar al carrito' on first product card
Verify product name and price in cart
expectedResult: Product added to cart, drawer opens, correct item displayed

title: Add product to cart from products page
description: Verify adding a product from the full catalog works
steps: Wait for product catalog to load
Click 'Agregar al carrito' on first product card
Verify product name and price in cart
expectedResult: Product added to cart, drawer opens, correct item displayed

title: Submit contact form with valid data
description: Verify form submits successfully with all valid fields
steps: Wait for contact form to load
Fill message: 'Hola, me gustaría saber más sobre sus auriculares.'
Verify WhatsApp opens or is triggered
expectedResult: Form submits, success message shown, WhatsApp integration triggered

title: Contact form validation - empty fields
description: Verify validation errors for empty required fields
steps: Wait for contact form to load
Click 'Enviar' button without filling any fields
Verify validation errors appear for all required fields
expectedResult: Validation errors shown for name, email, message

title: Contact form validation - invalid email
description: Verify validation error for invalid email format
steps: Wait for contact form to load
expectedResult: Email validation error shown, form not submitted

title: Click WhatsApp button in contact info
steps: Wait for contact info section to load
Verify WhatsApp chat opens (new tab/window or app)
expectedResult: WhatsApp chat opens with pre-filled message
